verdict.rationale: ROS 2 provides low-level building blocks (actions with feedback/cancel, lifecycle-managed nodes, topics) that could underpin a human-intervention workflow, but the evidence pack shows no actual feature for detecting autonomy failures, routing them to an operator queue, or handing control back after resolution — that is an application-layer capability ROS 2 does not ship out of the box. Missing for 10: any documentation of a fault-detection/escalation mechanism, an intervention-queue or ticketing construct, or operator handback protocol.
